summary: Serving reads compile against the three-tier lens; the graph RPC owner is undecided, so the RPC client is stubbed behind a trait and the remaining criteria are implemented.
evidence: 151 serving unit tests passed; native and Wasm Clippy passed with -D warnings.

decisions.title: Which engine owns the authenticated graph RPC?
decisions.question: The three-tier read needs an authenticated RPC to activate graph artifacts. The R9 register names graph-rs as the artifact owner but does not say whether serving-rs calls it directly or through the state engine's dispatch table.

options.label: serving-rs calls graph-rs directly
options.consequence: One fewer hop; serving holds a graph credential.

options.label: Route through the state engine dispatch table
options.consequence: Matches the R3 manifest; adds a typed row to contracts-rs.
